cuelith.songs.onboarding.1.title: Songs in Cuelith
cuelith.songs.onboarding.1.body: The left column has a new Songs tab: search by title, lyrics, author or songbook number and press “To playlist”. The song goes into the archive only once; the playlist gets a copy.
cuelith.songs.onboarding.2.title: Verses, choruses and order
cuelith.songs.onboarding.2.body: In the editor every section has a type and a number: Verse, Chorus, Pre-Chorus, Bridge, Intro, Ending, Others (V1, C1, P1, B1…). Write the projection order, for example “V1 C1 V2 C1 B1 C1”: the Chorus is written once and repeats by itself. Inside a section, a [---] line splits it into several slides.
cuelith.songs.onboarding.3.title: Live, and with other software
cuelith.songs.onboarding.3.body: While a song is on air, the keys V C P B I E O jump to the start of the next Verse, Chorus, Pre-Chorus, Bridge, Intro, Ending or Others; after the last one it starts again from the first. With “Preview” and “On air” a song reaches the screen without going through the playlist. You can import and export songs in OpenLyrics and ChordPro, open formats read by many programs, chords included.
cuelith.songs.action.exportAllHint: Saves all the songs (or those of the chosen library) in a single ChordPro file: it is the backup of your songs, read back with “Import…”.
